true_effects.Somnolence: female > male in active arms only
true_effects.Dizziness: female > male in active arms only (weaker effect)
true_effects.Somnambulism: rare and exposure-related; too sparse for a sex comparison
true_effects.Headache: female > male in ALL arms including placebo (baseline epidemiology, not drug-related)
true_effects.class_evidence_note: Published hypnotic evidence is mixed (2 of 6 class drugs report higher female exposure). It is related-drug context for SYN-401, not direct evidence; this trial's own PK is the drug-specific evidence.
true_effects.mechanism: lower female clearance: body weight plus a residual sex effect
